'''Hassat-durr''' was a family of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|techniques]] used by the [[Baran Do]] sages. Translated from the native [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Kel Dor (language)/Legends|language]] into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], it meant "lightning rod". The ''hassat-durr'' techniques suffused the user's body with electromagnetic radiation. Because of this, if the wielder did not have the skills perfected and attempted to use them during a storm, they would be repeatedly struck by lightning. However, when perfected, they allowed the wielder to disable [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetics]] and electric implants, interfere with shock shackles, become a range-boosting antenna for a comlink, and even emit a non-[[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] version of white [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Force lightning/Legends|Force Lightning]] for utility or combat, among other uses.<ref name="FOTJ:Outcast" />

The ''[[ayna-seff]]''&mdash;which translated to "dead brain"&mdash;technique was in the ''hassat-durr'' family. This technique took [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] three days to master, while it took [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] only two. [[Master of the Order (Baran Do)|Master of the Order]] [[Koro Ziil]] taught the skill to Solo in [[34 ABY/Legends|34 ABY]]&mdash;before Solo turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and became [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Caedus&mdash;but by [[43 ABY|the time]] of Skywalker's arrival on [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], Ziil had become [[The Hidden One|the leader]] of the [[Hidden Ones]], a secret sect of the Baran Do. [[Tila Mong]] then became Mistress of the Order, and she taught the ability to Skywalker. Luke Skywalker later used this power to control erratic electrical surges in the Jade's Shadow in order to prevent the ship from being damaged.<ref name="FOTJ:Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>
